title: Metal ion activation and DNA recognition by the Deinococcus radiodurans manganese sensor DR2539
authors: Mota C; Webster M; Saidi M; Kapp U; Zubieta C; Giachin G; Manso JA; de Sanctis D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物物理分析和晶体结构解析了锰传感器DR2539的金属激活及DNA识别机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，虽非AI/物理模拟方法，但结构建模与界面分析对TF-DNA互作机制研究有参考价值。
abstract: The accumulation of manganese ions is crucial for scavenging reactive oxygen species (ROS) and protecting the proteome of Deinococcus radiodurans ( Dr ). However, metal homeostasis still needs to be tightly regulated to avoid toxicity. DR2539, a dimeric transcription regulator, plays a key role in Dr manganese homeostasis. Despite comprising three well-conserved domains: a DNA binding domain, a dimerization domain, and an ancillary domain, both the metal ion activation mechanism and the DNA recognition mechanism remain elusive. In this study, we present biophysical analyses and the structure of the dimerization and DNA binding domains of DR2539 in its holo form and in complex with the 21 bp pseudo-palindromic repeat of the dr1709 promotor region. These findings shed light into the activation and recognition mechanisms. The dimer presents eight manganese binding sites that induce structural conformations essential for DNA binding. The analysis of the protein-DNA interfaces elucidates the significance of Tyr59 and helix H3 sequence in the interaction with the DNA. Finally, the structure in solution as determined by small angle X-ray scattering experiments and supported by AlphaFold modelling provides a model illustrating the conformational changes induced upon metal binding.
abstract_zh: 锰离子的积累对于清除活性氧（ROS）和保护耐辐射奇球菌（Deinococcus radiodurans, Dr）的蛋白质组至关重要。然而，金属稳态仍需严格调控以避免毒性。DR2539，一种二聚体转录调控因子，在Dr锰稳态中发挥关键作用。尽管其包含三个高度保守的结构域：DNA结合域、二聚化结构域和辅助结构域，但金属离子激活机制和DNA识别机制仍不明确。在本研究中，我们提供了生物物理分析以及DR2539二聚化和DNA结合域在其全息形式及与dr1709启动子区域21 bp伪回文重复序列复合物中的结构。这些发现揭示了激活和识别机制。该二聚体呈现八个锰结合位点，这些位点诱导对DNA结合至关重要的结构构象。蛋白质-DNA界面的分析阐明了Tyr59和螺旋H3序列在与DNA相互作用中的重要性。最后，通过小角X射线散射实验确定并由AlphaFold建模支持的在溶液中的结构，提供了一个模型，展示了金属结合诱导的构象变化。
